description: Rail Lines BNSF, UPRR is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. The objective is to delineate potential crude by rail routes across California, focusing on a subset of the Caltrans "California Rail Network" dataset. Specifically, this subset comprises Union Pacific Railroad (UPRR) and Burlington Northern Santa Fe (BNSF) routes, the primary carriers for crude by rail in the state. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are Rail, Alignment, Transportation, California, Subdivisions, CAOpenData, California Department of Transportation, California State Transportation Agency. The bounding box given is -122.4395,32.6622,-114.6054,42.0388. The hub shows 2023-11-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is This dataset is for public use.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
